{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order order_ids:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Remove QA orders
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Also remove refunded orders since they don't contribute to revenue
sales_clean = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = sales_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()
print("Revenue by channel (after cleaning and filtering):")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the most revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

print(f"\nChannel with most revenue: {max_channel} with ${max_revenue:,.2f}")"}
